（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

October 14th 1916

Sir,
The meeting of destitute rebels which was held in
the Zee Oen 全安 teashop Rue Kraetzer Frenchtown on the
13th inst was attended by about 1000 persons. These
formed themselves into a procession led by Waung Ih
Fei 王一飛 Yah Tsong Yeh 楊宗業 representing Kiangsu
province, Zung Kya Kwe 程家奎 representing Anwhui
province, and Zung Koh You 張國友 representing Shantung
province and marched to the office for repatriation,
at the West Gate. They found nobody there except servants
who telephoned to the Arsenal with the result that six
foot and twelve mounted Police appeared on the scene and
persuaded the rebels to go and wait in various teashops
in the vicinity. This they did and waited until about
noon when they began to clamour for food. One hundred
dollars was distributed among them and the trouble was
tided over for the time being but several minor
disturbances took place during the afternoon.
The Hweichow Guild on Arsenal Road has petitioned
Gen. Yang to remove his troops from the Guild and vicinity.
No settlement of the painters dispute has been
arrived at.

Your Obedient Servant,
Minnie Mussins
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（批：Entered in A/Stat
c Oct. 16. 9.6）

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股。）

1916年10月14日

先生：

本月13日，在法租界克拉策尔路（Rue Kraetzer）全安茶馆举行的贫困反叛者集会，约有1000人参加。这些人组成了一支游行队伍，由代表江苏省的王一飛（Waung Ih Fei）、楊宗業（Yah Tsong Yeh），代表安徽省的程家奎（Zung Kya Kwe），以及代表山东省的張國友（Zung Koh You）率领，行进至西门的遣返办公室。他们发现那里除了仆人外空无一人，仆人随后致电兵工厂，结果六名步警和十二名骑警赶到现场，劝说服这些反叛者前往附近各家茶馆等候。他们照做了，并一直等到中午左右，开始 clamouring（喧闹）要求食物。当局向他们发放了一百元，暂时平息了事态，但下午仍发生了几起较小的骚乱。

位于兵工厂路的徽州会馆已向杨将军请愿，要求其部队撤出会馆及周边地区。

油漆工纠纷尚未达成解决方案。

您顺从的仆人，
Minnie Mussins
首席侦探督察。

警察总监上尉。

（批注：录入于 A/Stat
c 10月16日. 9.6）

K 14/10

ASH
